name: Botpress
oneLiner: AI agent platform for building, deploying and managing custom chatbots and support agents across web, messaging and voice channels, with a visual builder plus code-level control.
bestFor: Restaurant groups with in-house developers or an agency partner that want a fully custom AI agent wired into their own POS, reservation and CRM systems, rather than an off-the-shelf restaurant tool.

updates.text: Raised a $25M Series B led by Framework Venture Partners, with Deloitte Ventures and HubSpot Ventures participating, to scale its infrastructure for production AI agents.
Changed its pricing structure for new workspaces from May 14, 2026; existing workspaces keep the earlier plan-plus-AI-Spend model.

features: Visual agent studio for designing conversation flows, with code hooks for custom logic
Autonomous LLM-driven agents that can call tools and APIs to complete tasks
Knowledge bases built from documents and websites to answer questions
One build deployed to web chat, WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, SMS and other channels
Prebuilt integrations and an integration hub, plus APIs for connecting POS, CRM or booking systems
Botpress Desk, a built-in AI helpdesk with human handoff that can also connect to Zendesk, Intercom and Freshdesk
Analytics and conversation logs for monitoring and improving agents

pricing.text: Free tier available; paid plans listed by third-party sources at about $89/month (Plus) and $495/month (Team), each plus AI usage, with custom Enterprise pricing. Pricing changed for new workspaces in May 2026, so confirm on botpress.com/pricing.

notes: Not restaurant-specific: Botpress is a general AI agent builder; no restaurant customer case study found. Customers listed are from Botpress's own case-study pages. Kia, Shell and Siemens are mentioned as customers in a 2023 Business Wire release and third-party reviews, but no Botpress case study was found, so they were left out. Dropped from current review: 'hundreds of thousands of agents deployed' (not re-verified) and the Hostie citation. The $89/month price is from third-party sites, and Botpress changed pricing for new workspaces on 2026-05-14; botpress.com could not be fetched to confirm current plan names and prices. Desk launch date not confirmed (docs say available on request for Team, Managed and Enterprise).
